parameters_rows.name: linear interpolation between one-foot knots
parameters_rows.reasoning: Hazus and USACE describe interpolation between tabulated depth-percent ordinates.

parameters_rows.name: valid source range
parameters_rows.reasoning: The source table ends at ten feet and newer Hazus describes ten feet as the utility-function maximum depth.

parameters_rows.name: freshwater-only numeric eligibility
parameters_rows.reasoning: Hazus does not vary damage by flood type; historical equipment guidance indicates materially different contamination and salinity consequences, while the current NEMA successor remains unreviewed, so unsupported states conservatively withhold.
parameters_rows.update_trigger: NEMA CS 70006-2026 and qualified salinity contamination and duration evidence are acquired and reviewed

parameters_rows.name: WSE-to-grade unit bridge
parameters_rows.reasoning: A same-datum elevation difference provides local grade depth; the factor is the exact SI-to-foot conversion.
